title: Feature 005 printed parts (rotation subsystem and the first compartments)
units: mm, right-handed, z up, bed at z = 0, STL binary
disclosure: Nothing was printed, measured or fitted. The files carry the hole compensation below as a starting guess. Print the coupons first, fix scripts/print_profile.json from what you measure, then run scripts/export_print_files.py again.

parts.label: Drum
parts.orientation: Upright, deck undersides on the bed, hub pointing up
parts.settings: 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layer, 4 walls, 5 top/bottom layers, about 30 % gyroid, 5 mm brim
parts.supports: needed, or tune bridging: 33.6 mm2 of downward faces off the bed at z = 14.8 mm
warnings: Eight clip arms are 1.2 mm thick and print upright, so they bend across layer lines; coupon C-6 decides whether to print them separately and flat (R17).
Each hook overhangs 0.7 mm with nothing under it; expect a rough underside.
The four decks are 1.0 mm thick plates up to 24 mm wide on the bed; use the brim and watch for warp (R8). Avoid ABS.
The D bore keeps its flat at 2.10 from the axis; only the round part grows with the hole compensation.
Zero rod play depends on the epoxy bond, not on the print (R13, coupon C-7).

parts.label: Housing platform
parts.orientation: Flipped: the top face (where the thrust ring lies) is on the bed, so it is the smooth first layer
parts.settings: 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layer, 4 walls, 5 top/bottom layers, about 30 % gyroid, no brim needed
parts.supports: needed, or tune bridging: 421.1 mm2 of downward faces off the bed at z = 3.0, 5.0, 5.35, 6.7 mm

features.rule: already 0.15 mm per side over the 3.0 spigot
unchanged; measure the real sensor first

warnings: The bearing seat is modelled 15.85 mm and must be reamed to 16.00 mm after printing (coupon C-1).
Printed this way the bearing ledge (hole 12 mm to seat 15.85 mm) is a 1.9 mm wide overhang ring 5 mm above the bed; it may need local support or a clean bridge.
The wall between the hall pocket and the tongue pocket is about 0.71 mm, below the proposed 0.8 mm minimum (C10, open).
The wall between the bearing seat and the tongue pocket is about 0.7-0.9 mm (C4, open).
The hall pocket is 4.0 x 3.0 x 3.0 mm with no wire exit; the exit is not designed yet (R18).
The four outlet-chute wall boxes under the platform (z -12 to -3) are drawn in the viewer but are not in the print list, so they are NOT in this file.
The platform plate is 6.70 mm thick, which is not a whole number of 0.20 mm layers; the slicer will round it by 0.1 mm.

Two 2 x 13 mm cheeks hang 23 mm below the floor (z -26 to -3) to hold the tongue servo; printed flipped they stand up from the bed. The 14 x 14.5 mm opening for the servo crank arm is cut through the floor at the front.
The servo seat is 23 mm between the cheeks for a 22.7 mm servo body; screw holes for the servo ears are NOT designed.

parts.label: Stepper mount
parts.orientation: Plate flat on the bed, columns and spigots standing up
parts.settings: 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layer, 4 walls (the 4 mm columns print nearly solid), 30-40 % infill
parts.supports: needed, or tune bridging: 19.8 mm2 of downward faces off the bed at z = 2.6, 11.0 mm

features.check: motor boss fits without wobble (coupon C-4)
M3 x 12 bites 9.4 mm without splitting

warnings: The M3 pilot hole wall is about 0.7 mm (R14); coupon C-4 chooses the pilot diameter between 2.5 and 2.7 mm.
The two 4 x 4 x 24.4 mm columns are tall and slender; check rigidity and print them without a draft in the slicer.
The screw heads and the motor boss clearance depend on the 9.65 and 3.55 mm holes (coupon C-4).

parts.label: Levelling base
parts.orientation: Plate underside (z = -58) on the bed, the four posts standing up
parts.settings: 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layer, 4 walls, 5 top/bottom layers, 30 % gyroid
parts.supports: needed, or tune bridging: 1572.0 mm2 of downward faces off the bed at z = 4.2, 34.0 mm

features.rule: already 0.3 mm loose over the M5 thread
features.check: M5 bolt turns in the nut without binding
nut drops in and cannot spin
M3 x 10 bites 8.4 mm without splitting

warnings: Three M5 hex-nut pockets open to the bed side: print them as 8.3 mm bridges and keep the nut flat; check the nut turns freely and cannot spin (coupon C-4 style fit test).
The four 4 x 4 x 23 mm mount posts are slender; the M3 pilot hole leaves about 0.7 mm of wall (R14).
The controller shelf (54.4 x 28 x 1.6 mm) is a bridge between four 4 x 4 x 28 mm posts; its underside is an unsupported span, so print it with supports or tune bridging.
The plate is a round 144 mm disc, so a 150 mm bed is enough.
A 3.6 mm wide, 2.5 mm deep ring groove holds the wall (0.3 mm clearance per side); a thin 3.5 mm floor remains under it. The fit is ASSUMED, so print a short test ring of the wall first.
Layer-1 boards lie on the plate with 2 mm spacing; nothing fixes them (screw bosses are not designed).

parts.label: Cylindrical shell, right sector
parts.orientation: Sector stood on its lower edge (the z = -54.5 edge on the bed)
parts.settings: 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layer, 3 walls, 20 % infill, 5 mm brim
parts.supports: needed, or tune bridging: 1107.1 mm2 of downward faces off the bed at z = 18.5, 64.5, 78.5 mm
warnings: A 3 mm wall standing 117.5 mm tall and curved: expect wobble and layer-line weakness; use the brim and print slowly.
The cup opening is 18 degrees wide (about 21 mm) and 16 mm tall (z -52 to -36), open to the bottom of the wall: print it as a bridge or add temporary supports.
The pin-servo shelf (23 mm wide, 2 mm thick, cut to the inside of the wall) and its web carry the servo; check rigidity.

Each sector has a 1 mm x 3 mm tongue on one edge and a matching 1.4 x 3.4 mm groove on the other (0.2 mm radial and 0.4 mm length clearance); the 0.8 mm skins either side of the groove are thin and may break. Fit is ASSUMED.

parts.label: Cylindrical shell, back sector
parts.orientation: Sector stood on its lower edge (the z = -54.5 edge on the bed)
parts.settings: 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layer, 3 walls, 20 % infill, 5 mm brim
parts.supports: none: no downward face steeper than 45 degrees off the bed
warnings: 3 mm curved wall, 117.5 mm tall; expect wobble and use the brim.

Each sector has a 1 mm x 3 mm tongue on one edge and a matching 1.4 x 3.4 mm groove on the other (0.2 mm radial and 0.4 mm length clearance); the 0.8 mm skins either side of the groove are thin and may break. Fit is ASSUMED.

parts.label: Cylindrical shell, left sector
parts.orientation: Sector stood on its lower edge (the z = -54.5 edge on the bed)
parts.settings: 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layer, 3 walls, 20 % infill, 5 mm brim
parts.supports: none: no downward face steeper than 45 degrees off the bed
warnings: 3 mm curved wall, 117.5 mm tall; expect wobble and use the brim.

Each sector has a 1 mm x 3 mm tongue on one edge and a matching 1.4 x 3.4 mm groove on the other (0.2 mm radial and 0.4 mm length clearance); the 0.8 mm skins either side of the groove are thin and may break. Fit is ASSUMED.

parts.label: Service lid
parts.orientation: Flipped: the top face is on the bed (smooth visible face), the 2 mm lip stands up
parts.settings: 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layer, 3 walls, 20 % infill, 5 mm brim
parts.supports: needed, or tune bridging: 188.4 mm2 of downward faces off the bed at z = 0.8 mm
warnings: A 144 mm x 3 mm disc: expect warp at the edge; use the brim and avoid ABS.
The engraved ring (1.2 mm wide, 0.8 mm deep) prints as a short bridge above the bed; it may sag.
The 2 mm lip is a single-wall-pair rib standing 3 mm up: handle with care.
It is held by gravity only: nothing stops it sliding off if the product is tipped (magnets or a bayonet are NOT designed).

parts.label: Pill trough
parts.orientation: Floor flat on the bed, side walls standing up (it is only tilted 15 degrees when assembled)
parts.settings: 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layer, 3 walls, 20 % infill
parts.supports: none: no downward face steeper than 45 degrees off the bed
warnings: Pills sliding at 15 degrees is ASSUMED; the real friction of the printed floor is unknown (a smoother floor or a steeper slope may be needed).
The high end rests on the chute walls and the low end on one 2 mm post from the base; screws or clips are NOT designed.
It stays inside the wall and ends over the cup; the 1.5 mm walls are thin.

parts.label: Pill cup
parts.orientation: Floor on the bed, walls standing up
parts.settings: 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layer, 3 walls, 20 % infill
parts.supports: none: no downward face steeper than 45 degrees off the bed
warnings: It stands on the plinth and slides out through the wall opening; it has no guide rails or stop yet, and nothing keeps it from sliding in too far.

parts.label: Pin rail block
parts.orientation: Foot plate on the bed, post and rails standing up
parts.settings: 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layer, 4 walls, 30 % gyroid
parts.supports: needed, or tune bridging: 73.6 mm2 of downward faces off the bed at z = 9.3 mm
warnings: The two carriage rails are 1.6 mm wide and 24 mm long, cantilevered from the post: print them slowly and check that they do not sag.
The foot plate sits on the platform top; its screw holes are NOT designed.

parts.label: Cartridge
parts.orientation: Upright, the guide-rail undersides (z = 5) on the bed
parts.settings: 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layer, 3 walls, 20 % infill
parts.supports: needed, or tune bridging: 70.0 mm2 of downward faces off the bed at z = 1.0, 7.0, 11.8, 29.0 mm
warnings: With the rails on the bed, the tube underside is 1 mm above the bed and bridges the 10.8 mm gap between the rails; use a clean bridge or add supports.
The catch ledges overhang 0.8 mm with nothing under them; chamfer if they sag.
The spring lug underside is 1 mm above the bed (it overhangs the rail line) and the peg is 1.2 mm thick; print the peg slowly and check the loop fit.
The bore is modelled 10.95 x 8.55 mm for a nominal 10.8 x 8.4 mm channel; the 1.925 mm walls are 4 to 5 perimeters.
The colour tag is a 1.2 mm raised plate; change filament at that layer or paint it.

parts.label: Cap
parts.orientation: Plate flat on the bed, knob up
parts.settings: 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layer, 3 walls, 20 % infill
parts.supports: none: no downward face steeper than 45 degrees off the bed
warnings: ASSUMED to be its own print. The hinge and the latch are not designed, so this file is only the lid plate and its knob.
The 14.8 x 12.4 mm plate matches the tube outside; with the real fit gap it may need trimming once the hinge exists.

parts.label: Slide blade
parts.orientation: Flat on the bed, wedge nose and tab up
parts.settings: 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layer, 3 walls, 100 % infill recommended
parts.supports: needed, or tune bridging: 19.4 mm2 of downward faces off the bed at z = 1.0, 6.5 mm

features.rule: five layers; elephant foot adds to the first one
features.check: caliper, slides in the 1.0 mm channel

warnings: The blade is 1.0 mm thick and slides in a 1.0 mm channel: the fit needs a test print, and elephant foot on the first layer will make it thicker.
The wedge nose is 0.3 mm thick at the tip, thinner than one 0.4 mm line or the 0.2 mm layer step; it will print as stair steps and rounded.
The outer 2 mm of the tab (where the spring peg stands) overhangs the blade with nothing under it; use a bridge or local support.
The tab slot is 5 x 4 mm; the pin is 3 mm, so no hole compensation is applied.

coupons.what: Four rings modelled 15.80 / 15.85 / 15.90 / 16.00 mm (1 to 4 dots), 5 mm deep, 0.8 mm wall. Ream the 15.85 ring to 16.00 and test a 625ZZ.
Round bore and D bore (5.35, flat 2.10) plus five pins 4.85 / 4.90 / 4.95 / 5.00 / 5.05 mm; pin length 18 / 21 / 24 / 27 / 30 mm gives the diameter. Finds the hole compensation.
Three boss pockets 3.15 / 3.25 / 3.35 mm, 1.4 mm deep, 0.6 mm floor, for the 3 x 1 mm magnet.
Plate with the 9.65 boss hole, two 3.55 screw holes, and two 4 x 4 column stubs with M3 pilot holes 2.5 (left) and 2.7 (right).
Block with two 3.30 mm square sockets 2.2 mm deep for the C-4 spigots.
Clip arm 1.2 x 6 x 16 mm with a 0.7 mm hook printed three ways: upright on a base, on its long edge, and flat.
Hub stub 16 mm diameter, 20 mm tall with the D bore (5.35, flat 2.10) for the epoxy bond test on the real rod.
